Task complete. PR #13: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/13

**What was delivered:**
- Real, live-verified inventory (via `ai-os-scripts/generate_engines_gateways_inventory.py`) mapping all 20 engines to existing prior art — found in compliance-tracker's `lib/engines/`, `lib/services/`, `lib/loops/`, `lib/guardrail-*`, plus the already-known `task-gateway.py`/`preflight-guard.py`/`risk-tier.py`/knowledge_engine.
- `ai-os/CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_2026-07-24.yaml` — the PART4 schema, populated with 5 real capabilities (gratuity_calculator, commission_calculator, gst_calculation_engine, trend_analysis_engine, capability_registry_dedup), designed to layer on top of the existing `capability-registry-service.ts` embedding index rather than duplicate it.
- `ai-os/20_ENGINES_10_GATEWAYS_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml` — embeds the inventory, an 8-edge dependency table, and a 9-phase build plan. Honestly flagged that no canonical 10-gateway name list exists anywhere on the server (only `task-gateway.py` confirmed) rather than inventing names.
- Both artifacts registered in `knowledge_engine` with resolved cross-relationships, and `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` updated (live server copy + repo copy).

**Final coverage verdict — all 20 engines:**
Intent, Context, CapabilityRegistry, Planning, Policy, Rule, Decision, Workflow, Automation, Integration, Document, Notification, Data, Metadata, Learning, UIComposition, Analytics, Audit, Observability = **partial** (19). Knowledge Engine = **full** (1). Zero engines are NONE.
